result: Female reproductive glands (spermathecae and parovaria) are required for ovulation in Drosophila. Hr39 and lz mutant females, which lack these glands, show severely reduced ovulation (0-2% vs 50% in controls within 6 hours post-mating) and reduced egg laying, despite normal mating success.

result: Notch signaling and Hindsight (Hnt) are required during development to form secretory cells in reproductive glands. Disrupting Notch signaling or depleting Hnt blocks secretory cell formation, and females lacking secretory cells show strong ovulation defects and reduced egg laying.
